description: Change the stop loss and/or take profit of an existing open position or pending order on the user's live MT5 account, by ticket. REAL MONEY: only call this after the user explicitly approved the exact ticket and the new SL/TP prices. The tool auto-detects whether the ticket is an open position (MODIFY_POSITION) or a pending order (MODIFY_ORDER) from the latest snapshot. Pass only the field you want to change; omit a field to leave it unchanged, or send it as null to clear it. Confirm the result with get_my_mt5_account. Requires a personal SocialForex API token. Create one at /mt5 (section "Connect an AI assistant (MCP)") and add it to the MCP client as header `Authorization: Bearer sfmcp_...`.

stopLoss.description: New SL price; omit to keep, null to clear

takeProfit.description: New TP price; omit to keep, null to clear

ticket.description: Ticket of the position or pending order (from get_my_mt5_account)
